controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: A published 150 × 74 × 74 km prolate-spheroid approximation. The third axis repeats the minor axis by assumption. Voyager resolves only a few pixels across Juliet, so the gray grid marks missing mapped surface coverage; it is not photographed terrain.
controls.title: Approximate shape model
controls.summary: A 150 × 74 × 74 km shape estimate from Voyager. Two axes are assumed equal; gray grid: no surface imagery.
